title: Scoped audit: all rational triangle equality cases and raw observation costs
body:
Deletion-optimal rational triangle graphs need not have the same raw-observation cost. This scoped audit extends Sagar Thakrar's [PR1284](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1284) with the complete equality classification: at p=4 there are seven labeled minimizers, one requiring three raw vertex observations and six K3,3 attachments requiring all eight. For every p>=5 the isolated triangle is the unique minimizer. The known three p=3 K2,2 minimizers require all six observations. PR1284's deletion theorem remains correct; it did not claim uniqueness.

The written proof also identifies the exact required raw-observation set for every recoverable retained graph. Two fully restored dirty-helper example words cost 42 and 128 primitives; these are implementations, not circuit minima or physical supplier prices. No new kappa, selected-frontier change or supplier adoption is claimed.

Validation: all 294,056 threshold graphs at p=3,4 checked by separate graph and F3 column-rank engines; all 1,984 observation subsets checked with rational row elimination and modular column elimination; 99 edge-restoration, 69 observation-omission and ten characteristic-two controls. Literal words cover 41 source/dirty/output basis columns and reject all 170 single-gate omissions. Registered Python 3.12 replay, six package test groups, optimized read-only relocation, independent Python 3.14 replay, research/selected tests, source pins and selected-record integrity pass. One existing repository test skips; hosted CI and full supplier replay are not claimed.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/triangle-equality-audit
```

Expected: `PASS_TRIANGLE_EQUALITY_AUDIT`, `PASS_TRIANGLE_EQUALITY_TESTS`, and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`.

Base: `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`; PR1284 pin: `e971a2e52abe9714de0bcb5c84cdc8faab7cc7c8`. Only `research/triangle-equality-audit/` is added. Seed 64, original donor adversarial-audit track. Final paginated overlap refresh covered 807 open PRs and 61 Discussion records: closest work is PR1284, explicitly credited, and the new distinction is equality rigidity/observation cost. Exact source hashes, certificate, limitations and open next questions are in the package.

Credit Sagar Thakrar's PR1284; woklerx's PR966; Sam Sung / the-missionary-company's PR669; Joel Pulikkan / GamingPuzzled's PR231; icekylinx/eumemic's paired-port lineage. Prepared for Philipp (mightyOil) with substantial OpenAI Codex GPT-6 Astra assistance in mathematics, implementation, verification and writing. Apache-2.0. Written proof and independent implementations within one AI-assisted session, not proof-assistant certification or independent human review.
